title: Non-European Mathematics Manuscripts: Multilingual Translation Drafts and Modern LaTeX Sources
description:
Working corpus of modern LaTeX readers and translations for selected non-European mathematics manuscripts and historical mathematical texts. This satellite record is intentionally reader-facing: readable top-level PDFs come first, followed by compact TeX/source artifacts and current work packets. Large raw source drops, page-image working archives, superseded drafts, and broad provenance bundles are preserved on the main project landing and bulk-preservation record instead of being re-uploaded here on every update.

Status at a glance. [#########-] front-facing reader set: reconstructed work-level PDFs and combined readers are current; [##########] al-Battani text stream: segments 1-100 are promoted as a trilingual Arabic/English/Chinese reference reader; [##########] al-Battani fixed-star catalogue: refreshed complete critical table edition with 485 stars, authoritative ecliptic longitude/latitude values, magnitudes, north/south signs, modern Bayer/Flamsteed identifications, and expanded description data; [#######---] remaining al-Battani numerical table stream: the geography gazetteer has 269 locality entries (93 regional midpoint rows and 176 city rows), and a partial chronology/Canon-of-Kings working edition is included; chronology collation, zodiac, terms, houses, and auxiliary tables remain active reconstruction work.

Current update. Refreshes the complete al-Battani fixed-star catalogue, refreshes the complete geography gazetteer packet, and adds a partial chronology/Canon-of-Kings working edition with data and build scripts. The reconstructed non-Battani work-level release and al-Battani v083 trilingual text/reference packet remain the current broader reader surface.

Source and provenance layout. Project-generated TeX and compact current work artifacts are attached here. Full raw/provenance preservation is maintained on the main project record, concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20393488, so this record can be updated without repeatedly moving multi-gigabyte working archives.

Workflow provenance: public-domain or openly available source witnesses are transcribed into TeX, translated where useful, checked locally, and published with artifacts so readers can inspect and improve the work. The default licensing target for project-generated transcription and translation layers is CC0 where legally available.
notes: Latest update refreshes al-Battani table-layer material: the complete fixed-star catalogue now uses the larger 14-page coordinate-and-description edition with updated CSV/source packet; the complete geography gazetteer remains present with 93 regional midpoint rows and 176 city rows; and a partial chronology/Canon-of-Kings working edition is added. Text segments 1-100 remain complete in the v083 trilingual reader. Chronology collation, zodiac, terms, houses, and auxiliary numerical tables remain in progress.
